'''Resonators''' are the obtainable playable characters of ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'', and individuals with the ability to resonate with certain objects or elements and manipulate their frequencies.

==Lore==
A Resonator experiences their Awakening when they first resonate with the frequencies of something in the world and gain their Resonance Ability, also known as their [[Forte]]. When this happens, a symbol known as a [[Tacet Mark]] appears some place on their body, with its exact shape determined by what is called their [[Rabelle's Curve]]. 

For most Resonators, their Rabelle's Curve classifies them into one of the following categories: [[:Category:Natural Resonators|Natural]], [[:Category:Mutant Resonators|Mutant]], or [[:Category:Congenital Resonators|Congenital]]. These categorizations generally follow a pattern of when and how the Resonator experienced their Awakening.

Experts believe that a Resonator's past experiences and subconscious mind influence their Forte. Their genetic information evolves Post-Awakening, and thus their unique [[Resonance Spectrum Patterns]] can be compared to samples of Spectrum Patterns of other existing things to determine what they have resonated with.

Exerting one's mental capacity, an exhausted emotional state, as well as other circumstances, can lead to a Resonator to [[Overclocking|Overclock]]; losing control of their Forte and endangering themselves and others. The exact triggers and effects of Overclocking are unique to each Resonator.

Each Resonator has a [[:Category:Character Forte Examination Report|Forte Examination Report]] that provides information on their status as a Resonator. 

==How to Obtain==
{{Main|Convene}}
The primary method of obtaining Resonators is through using {{Item|Radiant Tide|20|text=Radiant Tide}} or {{Item|Lustrous Tide|20|text=Lustrous Tide}} to [[Convene]]. Players can obtain Convene Tokens from:
*Rewards from completing [[Exploration Progress]] and [[Event]]s
*Rewards from Level Bundles
*Rewards from the Insider Channel in the [[Pioneer Podcast]]
*Bought for {{Item|Astrite|20|x=160}} in the Tidal Exchange
*Bought for {{Item|Afterglow Coral|20|x=8}} in the Item Exchange
*Bought for {{Item|Oscillated Coral|20|x=70}} in the Item Exchange (Limit of 7 each per [[Version|patch]])
